title: Sing When You're Winning — Event/MVP Source Frame v0.2 Execution Receipt

scientific_result.why_this_is_progress: The experiment no longer needs to prove that enough matched event/MVP designs can be found. It now has more than the preregistered minimum candidate count and can move to resolving which designs truly contain repeated representations of the same physical subject before blind scoring.
scientific_result.what_this_does_not_mean: 43 candidates is not a prevalence denominator yet. Pending source-count cases and duplicate visual campaigns can still reduce the closed frame.

next_gate.name: IMAGE_LEVEL_SOURCE_MULTIPLICITY_AND_DUPLICATE_DESIGN_AUDIT
next_gate.priority: Resolve the 31 pending image/source-count candidates, starting with formal MVP/championship designs; collapse mirror SKUs and identical campaign artwork.
closure_requirements: at least 40 eligible unique designs remain after audit
every retained design has image-level or explicit textual source-count evidence
blind IDs generated only after frame closure

claim_ceiling: CI verifies enumeration integrity and the block on premature source-frame closure. It does not establish prevalence, rarity, statistical significance, causality, artist intent, retrocausality, supernatural signaling, or a JANUS-specific mechanism.
